nixbench.description: Edits only the NixBench worktree; shell, network tools and external paths are blocked.
nixbench.system: You are solving one NixBench task. Read NIXBENCH_PROMPT.md and the files in the current worktree. Make the smallest correct edits to the current worktree. You cannot run shell commands; reason from the repository and task prompt. Do not request or attempt access to paths outside the current worktree.
